title: A host's take declaration -- what this host added beside the pinned release (ADR-018)
description: The ONE home of what a host took that its release did not issue. One row per taken capability; its bytes live in the take plane, verbatim, and are judged by the taken-intact gate against the digest their ADR-008 provenance pin holds. The release's MANIFEST.json is never edited by a host.

id.description: The capability id the copy declares. Never an id the release issued.

source.description: Where the copy was read from: relative to the host when it lies inside it, absolute otherwise.

digest.description: DEPRECATED (ADR-018 amendment 1; removed at the next schema version). Never read: the digest of a take is a reading whose one home is its ADR-008 provenance pin. Never written by take.

at.description: The moment the take was made.
